description: Create a new .klypix canvas from cards + connections and save it to the vault. The user opens it in the KLYPIX app (Canvas → Open). Prefer short, titled cards (one idea each) connected by meaningful arrows. For anything a person reads IN ORDER — steps, phases, checklists, sections — put the cards in `groups`: each group becomes a titled box with its cards stacked in the order given, boxes left-to-right; the loose grid follows arrows, not reading order, and scatters a sequence.

cards.description: The cards. 5-12 atomic cards is ideal for a mind-map; a checklist can be longer when grouped.

color.description: Hex color, e.g. #ef4444 for a risk/blocker.

group.description: Put this card inside the titled box of that name (created if missing), in card order. Alternative to listing it in `groups`.

heading.description: Bold title card for the main goal/topic.

text.description: Card text. First line is the card title.

from.description: Source card: index (0-based), title, or id.

to.description: Target card: index, title, or id.

groups.description: Titled boxes, each listing its member cards in reading order (index, title, or id). Ungrouped cards form a band above the boxes — good for the title card, a link, a legend.

cards.description: Member cards IN READING ORDER — index (0-based), title, or id. They stack top-to-bottom inside the box.

color.description: Hex border color for the box (default emerald).

columns.description: Split a long list into N columns, filled top-to-bottom then next column. Default 1 (2 when more than 12 cards).

title.description: Box header, e.g. "Part 1 · Get ready". Also the card's area.

width.description: Card width inside the box in px (default 340). Use ~520 for long prose cards so they do not become skyscrapers.

name: create_canvas
title: Create a KLYPIX canvas
